projects.name: Customer Data Cleanup
projects.description: CRM customer entity resolution, phone/email standardization and missing field imputation.

issues.explanation: 4 candidate duplicate customer clusters sharing identical email addresses with name variations.
issues.recommendedAction: Execute probabilistic entity resolution and deduplication merge.

issues.explanation: 2 nullable cells found without enterprise default values or imputation masks.
issues.recommendedAction: Impute missing demographic entries via statistical cohort medians.

issues.explanation: 2 RFC-5322 syntax violations (malformed domains, missing tokens, invalid periods).
issues.recommendedAction: Sanitize syntax, trim whitespace, and flag unrecoverable addresses.

issues.explanation: 20 telephone numbers missing international E.164 dial codes or mixed punctuation.
issues.recommendedAction: Standardize into E.164 canonical phone string based on Country_Code context.

issues.explanation: 3 domain boundary violations: negative age values or negative revenue entries.
issues.recommendedAction: Clamp negative metrics to absolute zero or replace with domain bounds.

operations.title: Identify & Deduplicate Customer Entities
operations.reason: Resolves 8 redundant customer records using string similarity + exact email matching.

operations.title: Context-Aware Missing Value Imputation
operations.reason: Imputes 2 missing values using demographic cohort regression without distorting variance.

operations.title: Validate & Sanitize Email Addresses
operations.reason: Trims malformed email delimiters, lowercase normalization, and flags 2 invalid syntax strings.

operations.title: Normalize Phone Numbers to ITU E.164
operations.reason: Standardizes 20 phone records into clean international format +[prefix][number].

operations.title: Outlier Clamping & Semantic Boundary Shield
operations.reason: Sanitizes 3 non-physical data points (negative age and negative revenue).
